messages:
Jen (CEO): Posting the follow-up here for hiring/org questions from today's all-hands. Short answers first, details after.
Leah (People Ops): Summary: no layoffs; reprioritizing ~10-15% of open roles toward infra, security, and compliance for the next two quarters to support Dedicated/Private launches.
Marcus (Head of Eng): Practically: SRE, runtime, and infra teams are first to receive new headcount. Product feature hires may be delayed but not cancelled.
Maya (EM): If my backend hire is delayed, what are options for my team?
Leah (People Ops): Options: internal redeploy (we'll prioritize internal transfers), temporary cross-team support, or delayed backfill. Talent will reach out within 72 hours with suggested paths.
Jon (SRE): Customers depending on Dedicated SLAs — any risk there?
Ravi (VP Product): Customer-impacting hires tied to SLAs are insulated. We'll keep necessary spend and hiring to meet commitments.
Leah (People Ops): We're publishing the headcount spreadsheet (function buckets + flagged roles) and a decision rubric this afternoon. Office hours Friday 9am PT to walk through.
Maya (EM): Any change to promotions/manager hiring?
Marcus (Head of Eng): Promotion cycles stay the same. We'll pause most new manager searches unless they increase reliability or scale capacity.
Jen (CEO): High-level: this is prioritization, not a cut. Managers + People Ops will work with impacted folks to find the best outcome. DM me if you need to escalate.
PeopleOpsBot: Doc uploaded: https://go.redwood/hiring-clarity (headcount buckets + FAQ).
Leah (People Ops): If you want to advocate for a paused role, DM me + Marcus with a one-paragraph case and one metric. We'll triage exceptions.
Maya (EM): Thanks — appreciate the clear process. :thumbsup:
